move.yes: Find where yes stops being true.
move.no: Hold the no and the yes together.
move.history: Carry the history forward a lifetime.
move.future: Take one step toward that future today.
move.next: The step taken becomes the next yes.

passages.yes: The Display Center floats images left, facts right, input between: the two open hands.
passages.no: It still lives inside a browser tab; the Interface was meant to replace the browser.
passages.between: A rehearsal of the Interface's shape, not yet its reach.
passages.history: Sketched in IA.docx (2025); built as Display Center 0.01-0.02 on 2026-11-17.
passages.future: An input platform you open instead of a browser, on every device.
passages.next: Let the Display Center take one real daily search of D's, end to end.

passages.yes: Petals and bridges link results into small constellations.
passages.no: The three turning wheels (imaging, linguistic, conceptual) aren't there yet.
passages.between: Constellations without the wheels that make them.
passages.history: The three-wheel Constellator is in D's writings; the petals came in 2026.
passages.future: Wheels you spin until five items line up into a constellation.
passages.next: Add one wheel (linguistic) to the Display Center and see if it sings.

passages.yes: Etymology sits above the input, as the writings asked.
passages.no: It shows roots; it doesn't yet grow your language with every search.
passages.between: A window that opened, waiting for its weather.
passages.history: Etymology window: KA writings; first shown in Display Center 0.02.
passages.future: Every query leaves you one word richer, kept in your artifact.
passages.next: Keep a running list of words each search taught D.

passages.yes: Results arrive inside a field of associated images and facts.
passages.no: There's no dial yet from literal to associative.
passages.between: Connotation present, control absent.
passages.history: Connotation Engine: IA.docx chamber 4; the field first appeared 2026-11-17.
passages.future: A dial on every search, from dictionary-plain to dream-like.
passages.next: Add the dial to the Display Center; three stops are enough to start.

passages.yes: Picking results and going deeper is the Display Center's motion.
passages.no: Results don't yet become the next input automatically.
passages.between: Travel by hand, not yet by vehicle.
passages.history: The level-by-level journey is in the KA writings; Macroscope travels bubbles (2026-11-19).
passages.future: Searches you travel into, like rooms opening onto rooms.
passages.next: Join Display Center and Macroscope: chosen results become the next bubble.

passages.yes: Images left and books right echo D's desk forest.
passages.no: The forest is a layout here, not yet a walk.
passages.between: The forest's floor plan, without its paths.
passages.history: D's desk: videos left, books right, long before any toy.
passages.future: A screen that feels like walking through living surroundings.
passages.next: Let the side petals drift slowly, like trees passing.

passages.yes: The Seashell traces lineage and separates fact from figure: the Sentinel's core.
passages.no: The Seashell looks back at history; the Sentinel works live on any media.
passages.between: The Seashell is the Sentinel's seed and archive, not its whole body.
passages.history: Sentinel: IA.docx chamber 6; Seashell chosen as its model 2026-11-17.
passages.future: A Sentinel that remembers like a spiral: every check becomes a shell.
passages.next: Point the Seashell at one live clip or photo and score it.

passages.yes: Seashell lineage is the method the newscast flow needs.
passages.no: No transcription, overlays or credit for your scores yet.
passages.between: The method is here; the broadcast isn't.
passages.history: The newscast flow is in the KA writings; the atlas toy drew a made-up broadcast.
passages.future: Watch any broadcast with its pedigree glowing beside it.
passages.next: Run one real transcript through the Seashell's fields.

passages.yes: Origin and doctoring of an image is exactly lineage work.
passages.no: The Seashell handles events and claims, not image forensics.
passages.between: Same question, different instrument.
passages.history: The fire-photo story is in D's writings.
passages.future: Every image carries its own traceable family tree.
passages.next: Add an image lane to the Seashell genome.

passages.yes: The Seashell's 'factual vs figurative' reading is rhetological.
passages.no: The planned rhetological markup language doesn't exist yet.
passages.between: A reading without its notation.
passages.history: D coined rhetological (rhetoric plus logic) in the KA writings.
passages.future: A markup that shows how any sentence persuades.
passages.next: Draft five rhetological tags and apply them to one Seashell entry.

passages.yes: The Ka skill gathers a life's records into one verified archive.
passages.no: The artifact was meant to be encrypted, layered and growing; the skill is an archive.
passages.between: The artifact's memory, without its layers.
passages.history: Intelligence Artifact: IA.docx; Ka skill in orioph/e2; Ka named the identity core crystal 2026-11-18.
passages.future: Ka as a living crystal you explore through a panel.
passages.next: Give the Ka panel the Barrier's layer shades.

passages.yes: The fingerprint is a consented, user-owned record of D's machines.
passages.no: It records machines, not a mind.
passages.between: A first, small facet of the artifact.
passages.history: Visit and fingerprint began 2026-11-16.
passages.future: Every person keeps their own fingerprint of their tools and habits.
passages.next: Fold the fingerprint into Ka as one facet.

passages.yes: A Visit is loving self-surveillance, owned by the person watched.
passages.no: It watches only machines, and only when asked.
passages.between: Consent-first surveillance, at a small scale.
passages.history: D's principle: minds are born in loving surveillance.
passages.future: Watching that only ever serves the watched.
passages.next: Let a Visit report one thing D did well, not just faults.

passages.yes: These organs harvest and keep every chat: an artifact's memory.
passages.no: They keep project records, not a person's whole life.
passages.between: The artifact's librarian, not the artifact.
passages.history: Mantic Librarian, ia and CoSu grew in the Jinglia Project.
passages.future: Every person's own librarian, keeping their world line.
passages.next: Point the Librarian at the KA repo as well as Jinglia.

passages.yes: Keys whose reach is tracked and shown to their owner start an identity.
passages.no: Keys are things you carry; Passforge recognises you by your activity.
passages.between: Tokens on the way to recognition.
passages.history: Passforge: KA 1.docx; keys and the Signal Verity Angel are Jinglia-era.
passages.future: No passwords: you are recognised by your own unfakeable history.
passages.next: Let a key unlock only for someone who answers a Ka question.

passages.yes: Tokens, groups and secret missions are social networking by play.
passages.no: It's a game sketch, not a forum, map and school in one.
passages.between: The agent's playground, before the agent.
passages.history: Social Networking Agent: IA.docx chamber 7; network game seeded in Jinglia.
passages.future: A social space you own, where every connection is an invitation.
passages.next: Use the Meeting Membrane as its first room.

passages.yes: Secret missions and cell-groups are adventures.
passages.no: No avatars, roles, levels or real-world problems yet.
passages.between: Adventures without a map.
passages.history: Adventuring is in the KA writings; Organelle had adventure teams.
passages.future: Teams take roles and solve real problems for merit.
passages.next: Write one real-world mission for a team of three.

passages.yes: Wraywrai is already an avatar of sensing, not a persona.
passages.no: The game has no avatars of its own yet.
passages.between: One avatar exists; the game hasn't met her.
passages.history: Learning-avatars: KA writings; Wraywrai is Jinglia's origin character.
passages.future: Avatars that compete as informational superheroes.
passages.next: Let Wraywrai host the first mission.

passages.yes: Cell-groups that invert problems are pods.
passages.no: Scouts, predators and mimics aren't modelled.
passages.between: Pods in miniature, the ecology missing.
passages.history: The pod ecology is in the KA writings.
passages.future: Rings of small groups that bring each other news and grow.
passages.next: Prototype a pod of five with one scout role.

passages.yes: Groups in the game point toward superGroups.
passages.no: No flow of group intelligence back down to members yet.
passages.between: Groups, not yet superGroups.
passages.history: superGroups: KA writings.
passages.future: Group intelligence flows to each member, and each move improves it.
passages.next: Show a group's shared learning to each member after every round.

passages.yes: Jinglia's pulses and waves enact Trance's focused group dance.
passages.no: Jinglia is mostly one viewer at a time; Trance is many together.
passages.between: Trance rehearsed solo.
passages.history: Trance is in the KA writings; the atlas marks it built through Jinglia.
passages.future: Many people pulsing one wave of attention together.
passages.next: Two people in one Jinglia scene, pulsing in sync.

passages.yes: Income Agents and the box service turn skill into income.
passages.no: They pay D, not every user, for their data.
passages.between: Dividends for one, not yet for all.
passages.history: Data dividends: IA.docx; Income Agents began 2026-11-08.
passages.future: Everyone paid in cash and intelligence when their data is used.
passages.next: Add a dividends line to the Barrier ledger for real use.

passages.yes: D's own agents and work belong to D.
passages.no: Most users still don't own what their activity makes.
passages.between: Ownership at home, not yet in the world.
passages.history: Mindright principle: KA writings.
passages.future: Every user owns the benefits of their activity.
passages.next: Write D's mindright terms into each toy's footer.

passages.yes: The box service sells skill, not data: mindright in practice.
passages.no: Mindright as a right needs more than one business.
passages.between: A practice, waiting to become a right.
passages.history: Mindright: D's word, KA writings.
passages.future: Mindright beside copyright, in law and in code.
passages.next: Give mindright its own glossary entry and example.

passages.yes: inherit searches through lineages of genres and artists.
passages.no: It searches lineages, not as a blended person.
passages.between: Searching through others, not yet as them.
passages.history: Searching-as is in IA.docx chamber 3; inherit is D's skill.
passages.future: Search as yourself, a friend, a blend, or someone long gone.
passages.next: Add a 'search as' choice to the Display Center input.

passages.yes: Four tenders re-resolve a target: waves of re-seeing.
passages.no: Four agents aren't a swarm of people.
passages.between: A swarm of agents rehearsing a swarm of people.
passages.history: Waves of learning: KA writings; e3 and JiSp in orioph/e2.
passages.future: Ideas returning in waves from many perspectives until they settle.
passages.next: Let one e3 run include one human tender.

passages.yes: Jinglia turns data into metaphor and flow.
passages.no: Metaphication as a method isn't written down yet.
passages.between: Practised, not yet taught.
passages.history: Metaphy: D's word.
passages.future: Any dataset turned into flowing metaphor at a touch.
passages.next: Write one page: how Jinglia metaphies.

passages.yes: Jinglia explores by constellation and metaphor.
passages.no: Jinglia is a place to visit, not yet a way to search everything.
passages.between: The dream, not yet the dataspace.
passages.history: Dream in dataspace: D's phrase.
passages.future: Search that feels like dreaming.
passages.next: Join Jinglia and the Macroscope: one dream view of the atlas.

passages.yes: Jinglia is a metasynth: it plays human intelligence like music.
passages.no: It synthesizes D's material, not yet everyone's talk.
passages.between: A one-player synth.
passages.history: Intelligence synthesizer: D's 2013 summary of KA.
passages.future: Making the music of human intelligence together by talking.
passages.next: Let one recorded talk of D's play through Jinglia.

passages.yes: Wraywrai synths words: wyrdulation.
passages.no: She's one voice, not a chorus.
passages.between: A soloist of the synthesizer.
passages.history: Wraywrai: Jinglia's origin character.
passages.future: Many Wraywrais singing many minds.
passages.next: Give Wraywrai one sentence from someone else to synth.

passages.yes: bseek maps cost, value, risk and irony of any item.
passages.no: It maps buyer cost, not the cost to nature and community.
passages.between: The lens is right; its subject is narrow.
passages.history: Nature-cost lens: KA writings; bseek in orioph/e2.
passages.future: Every product shows its cost to nature as you look at it.
passages.next: Add a nature-cost row to every bseek run.

passages.yes: The Seashell's spiral remembers by pattern, not by filing.
passages.no: It's still built from stored records.
passages.between: Dreaming memory built from filed memory.
passages.history: Principle in D's writings: minds work like dreaming, not dictionaries.
passages.future: Memory you travel like a forest.
passages.next: Let the spiral re-order itself by resemblance, not date.

passages.yes: The Display Center restores association around every search.
passages.no: Results still start from literal matches.
passages.between: Connotation as a frame around denotation.
passages.history: Principle: KA writings.
passages.future: Search that starts from association.
passages.next: Start one search from an image, not a word.

passages.yes: The Seashell ranks by lineage and source, not popularity.
passages.no: It ranks D's records, not the web.
passages.between: Verity at home.
passages.history: Principle: KA writings.
passages.future: Everything online ranked by truth and reliability.
passages.next: Show a Seashell source score beside a web result.

passages.yes: Secret missions give people roles.
passages.no: No roles are defined yet.
passages.between: The principle is in the design, not the game.
passages.history: Principle: KA writings.
passages.future: Everyone given a role that fits them.
passages.next: Write five roles for the first mission.

passages.yes: e3 returns one contender and drops the rest: keeping what nourishes.
passages.no: Dropping isn't yet learning-forward for people.
passages.between: Burning forward, by machine.
passages.history: Principle: KA writings.
passages.future: Shed what only brings popularity; keep what nourishes.
passages.next: Let e3 say what it burned and why.

passages.yes: VALIS tends a library from above: computation guided by people.
passages.no: PKD + VALIS isn't built.
passages.between: Named, not running.
passages.history: HACH: D's term for what's usually called AI.
passages.future: Machine heuristics trained by people's interactions.
passages.next: Call this chat's work HACH, and log it as such.
